3

3

via/export/import/out/quote/A1

-- out/export/outcome --
accepted
-- out/import/inputs --
via/import/quote/A1
  via/export/import/out/quote/A1

accepted
-- out/list/files.txt --
1 files
quote/A1 "3\n"
-- out/list/inputs --
files.txt
  via/import/quote/A1
-- out/list/outcome --
accepted

        + blocked export
        FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... runs import: it reruns export, whose outcome and product a normal run reads from the archive. What it writes for the cell, if anything, is its run's.
